projects.name: Azure DevOps Project Admin Audit Tool
projects.description: I built a Python audit tool for a Fortune 50 consumer goods company that finds non-compliant administrators across Azure DevOps organizations. It uses an async/await design with connection pooling, batching and retries to scan 5000+ projects, runs configurable compliance rules, and sends templated email reports via Jinja2. Credentials are encrypted with AES-256, audit records are stored in Oracle through SQLAlchemy, and logs go to Azure Blob Storage. With 92% test coverage across 250+ tests, a full audit now takes about 20 minutes — 10–15x faster.
projects.tech: Python, AsyncIO/aiohttp, SQLAlchemy, Oracle DB, Azure DevOps REST API, Azure Blob Storage, Pydantic, Jinja2

projects.name: Azure DevOps Branch Policy Enforcement Tool
projects.description: I built a Python automation tool for a Fortune 50 consumer goods company that detects and fixes branch-protection policy violations across Azure DevOps organizations. It processes projects in batches of 200 with retry handling to cover 5000+ projects, checks reviewer-policy compliance, applies fixes through concurrent enforcement pipelines, stores results in Oracle DB and emails reports via Jinja2. A dry-run mode makes changes safe to preview. Enforcement across all projects completes in under 30 minutes.
projects.tech: Python, AsyncIO/aiohttp, SQLAlchemy, Oracle DB, Azure DevOps REST API, Jinja2, SMTP

projects.name: Azure DevOps Security Permissions Audit & Remediation Tool
projects.description: I built a Python security audit tool for a Fortune 50 consumer goods company that detects and revokes unauthorized bypass permissions in Azure DevOps Git repositories. A four-phase async pipeline scans ACLs, extracts violations, resolves identities in batches and applies remediation across 5000+ projects. It cut identity API calls by about 50x, records to Azure Audit Logs for traceability, stores violations via bulk inserts, and sends automated alert summaries. A full audit plus remediation run finishes in under 30 minutes.
projects.tech: Python, AsyncIO/aiohttp, SQLAlchemy, Oracle DB, Azure DevOps REST API, Azure Audit Log API, Jinja2, SMTP
